# partiteai_installed_particle (Resource)

An installed particle backed by a particle artifact.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `artifact_id` (String) ID of the particle artifact backing this install.
- `name` (String) Resource name

### Optional

- `credentials` (Attributes List) Credentials to provision on the install. Each entry corresponds to one named credential declared in the artifact's manifest. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `kv_workspace_id` (String) Workspace backing this install's key-value state. Required when the artifact's manifest grants the KV capability, and rejected when it does not.
- `mounts` (Attributes Set) Mount bindings, each mapping a mount name declared in the artifact's manifest to the workspace exposed at it. The same workspace may appear under several names. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mounts))

### Read-Only

- `active_artifact` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--active_artifact))
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Required:

- `method` (String) Method being provisioned, named as the manifest names it under `credentials.<name>.methods`. An author picks these names freely, so this is not one of a fixed set: what kind of credential it is comes from whichever `*_wo` block is set below.
- `name` (String) Credential declared in the artifact's manifest, a key in its top-level `credentials` map.

Optional:

- `apikey_wo` (Attributes, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials--apikey_wo))
- `basic_wo` (Attributes, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials--basic_wo))
- `oauth2_client_credentials_wo` (Attributes, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials--oauth2_client_credentials_wo))
- `raw_wo` (Attributes, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials--raw_wo))
- `signing_key_wo` (Attributes, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials--signing_key_wo))
- `version` (Number)
